key.name: show-icon
key.description: Display the Kimi logo icon in the panel.

key.name: panel-gauge
key.description: Which usage gauge to draw in the panel: a circular ring, a horizontal bar, or none.

key.name: show-percentage
key.description: Display the usage percentage of the window selected by panel-window (e.g. "42%") next to the panel gauge.

key.name: show-reset
key.description: Display, in the panel, the time left before the window selected by panel-window resets.

key.name: show-monthly-budget
key.summary: Show the monthly overage budget row
key.description: Display a "Monthly overage budget" row in the popup when Kimi reports a dollar-based monthly charge cap (extra_usage). Automatically hidden when that data isn't present.

key.name: panel-window
key.description: Which usage window the panel ring reflects: the 5-hour window or the weekly window.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Which section of the top bar the indicator sits in: left (next to Activities), center (by the clock), or right (the status area).

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Where the indicator sits among the other items in its panel box. 0 is the first slot; larger values move it further along.

key.name: poll-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, to poll for updated usage.
